subject: Invoice bridge & deferred charge approval
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <billing@venturegrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Invoice bridge & deferred charge approval

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached is the October invoice for usage overage (VG_Invoice_202610.pdf). We see a one‑time spike from a customer migration that pushed usage above the committed capacity during Oct. Total outstanding is $147,600.

To keep your renewal momentum with the new committed capacity and avoid a collections path, we'd like to propose a bridge arrangement:
- 60% payment on receipt (due 14 days)
- Remaining 40% deferred over 3 monthly installments (two equal installments + final smaller balancing payment)

We can also issue a one‑time credit if you accept a deferred schedule and commit to the expanded capacity on the renewed term. No change to the rate table — this is purely a timing/one‑off settlement.

Can you confirm whether VentureGrid can accept the bridge schedule? If yes, Ben will prepare the DocuSign for signatures and accounting will reissue an invoice showing the deferral line and payment schedule.

Attachments: VG_Invoice_202610.pdf (PDF)

Next steps: please confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can have paperwork ready before your month‑end close.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0123

P.S. If you need the line‑by‑line usage export, I can pull it and attach it in a follow‑up.

From: Alicia Ramos <billing@venturegrid.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice bridge & deferred charge approval

Logan —

Thanks for the proposal and for sending the invoice. VentureGrid is open to a payment plan in principle, but Finance needs three things before we can sign:
1) A clear usage breakout showing the spike and the committed vs actual usage bins (line detail).
2) The contractual basis for deferred charges (where in the SOW/contract this can be added or an addendum template).
3) Confirmation of any goodwill credit amount and how it will be reflected on the reissued invoice.

Without that, Treasurers usually push to pay the full balance and then request a credit after the fact, which adds extra steps. We could do it if Redwood provides an escrow instruction for the deferred portion (custodial) — that typically satisfies our auditors.

Can Ben share the usage export and a simple addendum draft? Also please include the email address to which we should return the signed DocuSign.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Director, Finance — VentureGrid
billing@venturegrid.com | +1 212‑555‑0444

Attachment referenced: Bank‑agent details (we will need to review).

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <billing@venturegrid.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice bridge & deferred charge approval

Alicia —

Appreciate the quick reply. I've attached the usage export and a one‑page addendum draft that we use for deferred settlements (see attachments). Summary below:

- Invoice total: $147,600
- Proposed near‑term payment: $88,560 (60%) due within 14 days of signed DocuSign
- Deferred balance: $59,040 (40%) split into two equal installments of $29,520 across the next two monthly invoices (months +30 and +60 days)
- Goodwill credit proposal: Redwood to issue a $18,500 credit contingent on VentureGrid signing the renewed 12‑month committed capacity by Dec 15, 2026. The credit will be reflected as a separate line on the reissued invoice.

Per your audit ask, we've added escrow instructions for the deferred balance (draft attached: escrow‑instructions‑draft.pdf). If that looks OK to you, I'll push the DocuSign envelope to the billing@venturegrid.com address and copy your treasurer. DocuSign link will include the reissued invoice and the addendum.

Attachments: usage_export_202610.csv (CSV), deferred_addendum_draft.docx (DOCX), escrow‑instructions‑draft.pdf (PDF)

Please confirm the email to send DocuSign to and whether the two‑installment schedule works for your accounting.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Renewals Manager — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 650‑555‑0971

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T08:53:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice bridge & deferred charge approval

Team —

I reviewed Ben's proposal. Approve the bridge approach with the following modifications:
1) Compress the deferred schedule to two payments over 2 months (30 / 60 days) instead of 3 — we need faster cash realization for Q4.
2) Approve a one‑time goodwill credit of $18,500 contingent on the signed renewal by Dec 15.
3) Accounting: include an accounting memo and revenue recognition code on the reissued invoice (GL: 4010‑DeferredRevenueAdjustment). Send the memo to accounting@redwood.ai after signature.

Ben — please update the addendum to reflect the 2‑payment deferred schedule and add the accounting memo. Loop Legal if the addendum language changes materially. Once updated, send the DocuSign to Alicia at billing@venturegrid.com and CC Treasurers (per their reply).

Also, include the HubSpot deal link in the envelope so CS can mark the renewal closed upon signature.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0164

From: Alicia Ramos <billing@venturegrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: treasurer@venturegrid.com
Date: 2026-11-12T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice bridge & deferred charge approval

Ben/Logan —

VentureGrid accepts the updated terms as summarized in your last note. We will:
- Sign the DocuSign envelope (attached signed copy: docusign-signed-bridge-VG-2319.pdf)
- Pay the initial 60% ($88,560) within 14 days of signing to the bank details on the invoice
- Place the deferred 2‑payment balance into the escrow arrangement you provided (we will return a countersigned escrow agreement to you by close of next week).

Please reissue the invoice showing:
- Original charge: $147,600
- Applied credit: $18,500 (description: goodwill credit contingent on renewal)
- Net due now: $129,540 (60% due shown as a payment schedule line)
- Deferred balance: $59,040 (escrow) with payment milestones and escrow agent details.

Once we receive the updated invoice and the countersigned escrow, Treasury will route immediate payment for the initial tranche.

Thanks for working with us — Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Director, Finance — VentureGrid
billing@venturegrid.com

Attachments: docusign-signed-bridge-VG-2319.pdf (signed envelope), countersigned‑escrow‑template-request.txt (placeholder request)
